<!-- pr-reviewer: a8e51d7ec9edfe4f946dc29811f3f8397d54a54c -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The PR also conflicts with `main` in code (`pocket_avoid.rs`).

This is a safety-floor review (2D toolpath motion, P1). I read the diff against #3744, #3741, #3743, #3748, #3788, #3316 and `docs/decisions/3744-one-ring-set.md`.

### What looks good
- One ring set: `level_pieces(.., around)` plus `ring_side::mirror` is a small change. Inside stays the old order. The multiset pin compares the two sides after a normalisation.
- Auto is decided in one place (`ring_side::resolve`). Auto with no footprint is Inside. A NaN tool radius gives a named error.
- The leftover-area fallback is still named. `side_plan` emits `side.fallback_note(left)` (a `StrategyFallback`), and `the_offset_guard_fallback_warning_names_the_pass_start` is green. The note names the resolved side ("Inside" or "Outside"), not "Auto". The decision file records this.
- Dead-end ramp (step 6): the PR removes only the automatic #3567 marks round a part (`level_order.rs:143-148`). A solid restart still uses the entry that the user selected (`with_solid_restart`, `ladder_links.rs` #2265 branch). This agrees with the #3748 rule: automatic entries go, and a user-selected Helix, Ramp or Plunge stays. #3748 still owes its warning.
- `share_ends` snaps within `SNAP` and includes the closing chord. `a_ring_end_off_the_boundary_chord_by_microns_is_shared` is red on the old 1 nm, open-chord test, so it is a real pin.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. The index math in `share` is bounded (`n >= 2`, `% n`). The provenance lines are present.

### Results (PR head `a8e51d7ec`, locally, not merged: see blocker 3)
The trial merge with `origin/main` `3c68dcaf2` conflicts in code, so I built the PR head. Base for the plans: merge-base `6167d30af`.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion --lib ring_side` (4 new pins) | 4 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels` (incl. 3 `one_ring_set` pins) | 10 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --test pass_start_engagement` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start` (debug) | 6 passed, 2 ignored (heavy) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Heavy lanes
- `app heavy: offset_pass_start` (the targeted P1 step), release, run by this review: ok in 506 s, 2 passed. It passes only on the loosened assert (blocker 1).
- The other reached lanes (`app heavy` and `motion heavy`, every target) were not run. They run at the cut.

### Requested before merge
1. **Class: a toolpath reading moves to an unsafe value, and the assert is loosened to hold it.** `crates/app/tests/offset_pass_start.rs:208-211`: `fig8_outside_offset_cuts_no_move_at_full_width` goes from 0 full-width points to "at most 520, all at the waist".
   - #3316 (the source of this pin) says: "A fully engaged slot overloads the tool ... a toolpath that the user must not run". Its Done-means is "no move whose engagement is a full slot". On this fixture the stepdown is 10 mm with a D8 tool, so a full-width cut is a 1.25 D slot at a feed set for a 2 mm stepover. That is a tool-load risk, not only a lower finish quality.
   - The cuts are silent. #3788 says that `level_order::full_width_at` does not name them, so the user sees no warning. Outside is the value that a user selects to stop slots (#3316). On fig8, Auto now resolves to Outside, so the default setting also gets the 495 unnamed points.
   - The Prime Directive says: log diagnostics, never hide them. AGENTS.md also says that an unsafe result must not pass silently. The bound of 520 hides a toolpath change.
   - The rule that closes the class: **each full-width cut that the plan emits is named on the path, by the same law that `flanks::full_width_points` measures.** The heavy pin then asserts 0 unnamed full-width points, not a count bound. Choose one way to do this:
     - (a) fold the #3788 fix in;
     - (b) where the one-set walk gives a full-width cut at a ring merge, keep the old stock-parallel Outside rings for that area, with a named note, until #3788 lands;
     - (c) make `full_width_at` agree with the flanks meter, so that the narrow note names the waist cuts.
     I recommend (c) as the minimum, plus (a) or (b). A named warning alone still leaves a slot in the default Auto path.
   - The PR body calls #3788 "P3". It is P1. Please correct the body.
2. **Class: line ends committed as CRLF.** 10 files are committed with CRLF ends. `main` has LF in all of them. As a result, `generate.rs` shows +4496/-4495 for a 5-line change, and the PR diff is 6870/6323 lines for about 600 real lines. The files are `generate.rs`, `level_order.rs`, `level_rings.rs`, `machining2d/mod.rs`, `pocket.rs`, `pocket_avoid.rs`, `ring_side.rs`, `ring_side_tests.rs`, `tests/pass_start_levels.rs` and `tests/pass_start_levels/one_ring_set.rs`. This churn causes the conflicts in `generate.rs` and `mod.rs`, and it breaks `git blame`. Fix: convert these files back to LF (for example `git add --renormalize` with `core.autocrlf=input`, or `dos2unix`) in a new commit. The rule that closes the class: a `.gitattributes` line `*.rs text eol=lf` (with `*.md` and `*.toml`). Put that in its own small PR or follow-up issue, not in this PR.
3. **Conflict with `main` in code.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_avoid.rs`: `main` moved the per-level plan into `pocket_avoid_level.rs` (`plan_avoid_level`). The `ring_side::resolve` call of this PR (`pocket_avoid.rs:147-148`) must move to the new site. If only line ends are ignored, this file is the only real conflict. Please merge `origin/main` (no rebase), move the call, and run the targeted gate again.
4. **Class: an issue pin is missing, but the PR closes the issue.** #3744's Done-means lists four pins. `fig8_start_sides_have_no_crossing` (Inside and Outside on `testdata/models/fig8.step`, no `Warning::Crossing`) is not added, and the PR body says that Inside on fig8 was not read for crossings. The maintainer's Inside run gave 414 Crossing warnings (#3744). `the_one_ring_set_posts_no_crossing_feeds` is a plain guard: the issue says that the dog bone already gave 0 crossings, so it was not red first, and for Inside it proves nothing new. Add the fig8 pin for the two sides. Or change `Fixes #3744` to `Refs #3744` and file the pin as a P1 follow-up.

### Notes (not blocking)
- Units: the test doc (`ring_side_tests.rs:94`), the decision file and the PR body say "3 um off its chord". The fixture uses `3e-6` mm (3 nm), and `SNAP` is `1e-4` mm (0.1 um). An end 3 um off its chord would not be shared. Please give the real reading from `shoulder_adaptive` in the correct unit.
- `the_mirror_reverses_each_piece_and_swaps_the_ends_of_the_order` is a plain unit guard of a new function, so it cannot be red first. That is acceptable.
- `resolve` excludes `Adaptive`, but `side_plan` includes it in `rings`. Auto plus Adaptive round a part keeps the old plan. This agrees with the decision file.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is about 4500 lines, already far over the 400-line rule. This PR does not make it longer.

The first needs-rework comment names the class of each finding. Please close each class with one rule, not only the one case. The PR keeps its ready state as set (#3727).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 6be6b1265d40e677647c829d17a16d41c17dec02 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a delta re-review at the safety floor (2D toolpath motion, P1). I did not rely on the author's readings: I measured them again.

### The four findings of the review at `a8e51d7`
1. **Unnamed full-width cuts (fig8 Outside): closed.** `level_order::order` now uses the flanks law of the meter (`level_flanks.rs`). The fills of `ring_fill.rs` remove 474 of the 495 points. The remaining points are named (see below).
2. **CRLF: closed.** `git ls-files --eol` gives `i/lf` for all 16 files of the PR.
3. **Conflict in `pocket_avoid.rs`: closed.** The `resolve` call moved to `pocket_avoid_level.rs:79-80`. The PR head already contains `origin/main` `db3bb1f7f`, so the trial merge is "Already up to date".
4. **fig8 crossing pin: closed.** `fig8_start_sides_have_no_crossing` is present. It is green for Inside and Outside.

### Checks of the naming (a local mutation, not committed)
- I removed the `narrow_note` push in `level_order.rs:166` and ran the two heavy pins in release. Both failed:
  - `fig8_outside_offset_cuts_no_move_at_full_width`: `21 full-width cut(s) are not named, the first at Point2 { x: 46.380203, y: 60.812059 }: []`
  - `fig8_inside_offset_names_each_full_width_cut`: `9 full-width cut(s) are not named, the first at Point2 { x: -39.791854, y: 17.621662 }`
- Thus the pin is real for the "no note" case. The note starts with `Pass start`, so `approach_page::entry_status_lines` shows it as a warning line on the op page (`a_pass_start_warning_is_a_status_line`).
- The 21 Outside points are 7 XY places, the same on each of 3 levels. Each place is one meter sample (the meter samples each 0.125 mm). Two places (X 18.655 and X 18.927) are 0.38 mm apart at one corner. No place is a run of samples along a length.

### The 21 corner samples against #3316
- #3316 forbids a full slot along a move. These points are an engagement peak of one sample at a ring corner, not a slot along a length. The plan names them, and #3788 stays open for them (`Refs #3788`).
- I judge this acceptable with the name, by the coordinator's rule (c) for a partial (a). It is not a blocker. The heavy assert is `<= 21`, and each place is named. No assert hides an unnamed cut.

### `ring_fill` safety (read)
- No gouge: a fill is the distance curve `hc.offset(d)` with `d` from `0.25` to `0.75` step past ring `j - 1`. It is clipped to `zone.offset(tool_r) ∩ c` (`ring_fill.rs:104`). Thus it stays in the cutter-centre area, as the rings do.
- No crossing: a fill is a level curve of the same distance as the rings, so it cannot cross a ring. The fig8 crossing pin is green on both sides.
- No cut outside the stock: the clip area is inside `c`, so a fill does not go farther than the rings.

### Results (locally, PR head `6be6b1265`, which contains `origin/main` `db3bb1f7f`)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion --lib -- machining2d` | 277 passed, 22 ignored |
| `camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels` | 10 passed |
| `camcraft-motion --test pass_start_engagement` | 6 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start` (debug) | 6 passed, 4 ignored (heavy) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run` | 284 steps planned; the full quick gate was not run (more than 30 minutes) |

### Heavy lanes
- `app heavy: offset_pass_start` (the targeted P1 step), release, run by this review: ok in 218 s, 4 passed.
- The other reached lanes run at the cut ("Heavy lanes at review").

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- The pin checks that the narrow note exists and that its first place is the meter's first place. It does not check the count. A plan that names only the first of two separate places passes. The decision file drops a note for each place, so this agrees with the decision. A count check is a possible follow-up on #3788.
- Inside: the meter reads 10662 points. Only 9 are off the part wall. The wall note names the others.
- Auto on fig8 is now Outside, so the default setting also gets the 21 named corner samples. The PR body says this.
- The fig8 Outside path also has six `entry: ... plunged into material at the plunge feed` notes at Y 123 (Z 12, 2 and 1.5). They are named. I did not compare them with `main`. Please confirm if they are new with the one ring set.
- The full quick gate has not run on this head. The merging session must make sure that the quick gate is green before the merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
